table.$comment: A table the consumer writes, dressed element by element: the table, its caption, header cells, cells and the frame it scrolls in. It stands on no control axis, because a cell is not a control: the padding comes off the spacing scale, so the density scope tightens a table with everything else, and the type is the body size. The only colours of its own are the header's surface and the lines: the cells paint nothing, so a table sits on whatever surface holds it.
table.$comment-padding: `space.3` and `space.4`, the two steps the compact density re-points, so a dense page gets dense rows without a table input of its own.

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of a cell and a header cell.

padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding of a cell and a header cell.

heading-fg.$description: Text colour of a header cell.

heading-font-weight.$description: Font weight of a header cell.

caption-gap.$description: Space between the caption and the table.

toggle-gap.$description: Gap between a sortable header's label and its chevron.

table.$comment-toggle-target-min: The floor a finger gets on a sortable header (`req-a11y-touch`). The cell's padding clears it at the body size; this is what a skin that shrinks the padding runs into.

toggle-target-min.$description: Touch-target floor of a sortable header.

table.$comment-icon-fg-muted: The chevron of a column not yet sorted, shown under the pointer or the focus as the order a press would give. The muted text colour, so the hint reads quieter than the sorted column's chevron, which takes the header's own text colour.

icon-fg-muted.$description: Colour of the chevron a sortable header shows as a hint.
